name: SoundSense
tagline: Real-time sound alerts for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, prioritising alarms and sirens.

awards: Best Use of MemryX Edge AI Accelerator

problem: Deaf and hard-of-hearing people miss important environmental sounds.
solution: YAMNet on an edge accelerator classifies hundreds of audio events and shows visual alerts by priority, from fire alarms to doorbells.
demo_moment: Team-described: play a smoke alarm and see a critical alert.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of MemryX Edge AI Accelerator” among 122 submissions.

lessons: Rank alerts so the critical one is never lost in noise.
